title: Hinge leaf

description.en: One leaf of a butt hinge. The leaf is a plate 40 x 30 x 2 mm (X from 0 to 40, Y from 0 to 30, Z from 0 to 2). Along its front edge (Y = 0) it has two knuckles: cylinders of 6 mm diameter on an axis along X at Y = 0, Z = 3 (so their bottom is flush with the plate's underside), 12 mm long, one at each end (X from 0 to 12 and from 28 to 40). Between them the plate is cut back round the same axis with 0.5 mm clearance (radius 3.5 mm), to make room for the other leaf's knuckle. A 2.5 mm pin hole runs through both knuckles on their axis. Two 4 mm screw holes go through the plate at X = 10 and X = 30, Y = 20. Drive it by the variables leaf_w, leaf_d, thickness, knuckle_d, knuckle_len, clearance, pin_d, hole_d and hole_y.
description.nl: Eén blad van een scharnier. Het blad is een plaat van 40 x 30 x 2 mm (X van 0 tot 40, Y van 0 tot 30, Z van 0 tot 2). Langs de voorrand (Y = 0) heeft het twee knopen (scharnierogen): cilinders van 6 mm diameter op een as langs X op Y = 0, Z = 3 (zodat hun onderkant gelijk ligt met de onderkant van de plaat), 12 mm lang, één aan elk eind (X van 0 tot 12 en van 28 tot 40). Daartussen is de plaat rond dezelfde as weggenomen met 0,5 mm speling (straal 3,5 mm), om plaats te maken voor de knoop van het andere blad. Een pengat van 2,5 mm loopt door beide knopen op hun as. Twee schroefgaten van 4 mm gaan door de plaat op X = 10 en X = 30, Y = 20. Stuur het met de variabelen leaf_w, leaf_d, thickness, knuckle_d, knuckle_len, clearance, pin_d, hole_d en hole_y.

variables.name: clearance
variables.meaning: radial clearance of the cut-back between the knuckles

expect.value: leaf_w * leaf_d * thickness + 2 * knuckle_len * (pi * (knuckle_d / 2)^2 - (((thickness - (knuckle_d / 2)) * sqrt((knuckle_d / 2)^2 - (thickness - (knuckle_d / 2))^2) + (knuckle_d / 2)^2 * asin((thickness - (knuckle_d / 2)) / (knuckle_d / 2)) / 1 rad) / 2 - ((-(knuckle_d / 2)) * sqrt((knuckle_d / 2)^2 - (-(knuckle_d / 2))^2) + (knuckle_d / 2)^2 * asin((-(knuckle_d / 2)) / (knuckle_d / 2)) / 1 rad) / 2)) - (leaf_w - 2 * knuckle_len) * (((thickness - (knuckle_d / 2)) * sqrt(((knuckle_d / 2) + clearance)^2 - (thickness - (knuckle_d / 2))^2) + ((knuckle_d / 2) + clearance)^2 * asin((thickness - (knuckle_d / 2)) / ((knuckle_d / 2) + clearance)) / 1 rad) / 2 - ((-(knuckle_d / 2)) * sqrt(((knuckle_d / 2) + clearance)^2 - (-(knuckle_d / 2))^2) + ((knuckle_d / 2) + clearance)^2 * asin((-(knuckle_d / 2)) / ((knuckle_d / 2) + clearance)) / 1 rad) / 2) - 2 * knuckle_len * pi / 4 * pin_d^2 - 2 * pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness

derivation: Per unit length along X, the plate's part inside a circle of radius rho about the axis (Y = 0, Z = R) is the strip Y >= 0, 0 <= Z <= t of that disc: H(rho) = int_{-R}^{t-R} sqrt(rho^2 - u^2) du = F(t - R) - F(-R), with F(u) = (u sqrt(rho^2 - u^2) + rho^2 asin(u / rho)) / 2.

Each knuckle adds its cylinder less what the plate already has there: k (pi R^2 - H(R)). The cut-back between the knuckles removes (W - 2k) H(R + c). The pin hole lies wholly in the knuckles' material over 2k (in the gap it passes through air): 2k pi dp^2/4. The screw holes take 2 pi dh^2/4 t.
The knuckles' bottom is tangent to the plate's underside along the line Y = 0: the union has a smooth (tangent) edge there.
